data.topic: Running orders, pricing and support with a team of 40: which decisions belong at the center, and which stay with the account owner.
data.topic_note: One question goes around the table once. After that it is open.
data.menu: Four courses from the Cormorant kitchen, served family style. Shellfish, a braise, roasted roots, one shared dessert.
data.menu_note: A vegetarian path through every course. Wine with each course, or not.
data.dress_note: Come as you are from the lab or the office.
data.why_you: The table is for people who run commercial operations at a company this size, and the talk is about how they split the work between the center and the account owners.
